svg.title: UHF and HFCT global–regional PRPD experts with gated logit fusion
svg.desc: Two parallel sensor branches construct a global PRPD and three 120-degree regional views. Four independent frozen ResNet50 encoders per modality merge their features into a 512-dimensional vector; a classifier produces four logits and softmax probabilities. L2-normalized features, full class probabilities, maximum probability, top-two margin and normalized entropy form the 1038-dimensional gate input. A 1038-to-64-to-2 MLP and softmax produce two weights for a convex combination of the raw branch logits. Sensor icons, waveforms and PRPD points are illustrative, not experimental observations.

g.font-family: Times New Roman, Liberation Serif, serif
g.text: Dual-channel PRPD recognition with gated fusion
Four views per sensor: global + three 120° regions
[ L2(hU), L2(hH), pU, pH, qU, qH ]
